findings.title: New benefit hook accepts closed/question/paid/history context

cases.synthetic_text: The software certification exam fee is now waived. This offer is over.
Does anyone know whether the developer certification exam fee is now waived?
The software certification exam fee is now waived only with a paid subscription.
Last year's announcement said: 'The developer certification exam fee is now waived for students'.

findings.detail: Whole-text helper executes after existing clause guards and can revive a rejected statement. Direct past-tense and basic not-waived controls pass, but equivalent suffix/question or historical quotation contexts do not.
findings.minimal_fix: Add scoped tests for these exact contexts and share or extend the existing intent/closure guard without suppressing genuine waiver and host-support announcements.

findings.title: Unrelated developer/software mention supplies scope for non-developer benefit

cases.synthetic_text: Software industry news. The driving exam fee is now waived for motorists.
Developer biography. Company picnic hosts will receive T-shirts. Apply to host a Fest.

findings.detail: Scope is required only somewhere in the text, so unrelated driving certification or company-picnic swag can acquire developer scope from another sentence.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind the technical/developer scope to the claimed certification or event with bounded contextual rules and retain the intended long-form developer-event positives.

qualification_boundary: In the three reviewed files this is a boolean discovery branch. No evidence/status/account-eligibility promotion is introduced by the branch; whole-system qualification behavior was not re-audited.
limits: All new counterexamples are synthetic development checks, not a new holdout or 95% acceptance.
No retired sample, original data, DB, report, network or paid API used.
No worktree/product edits or full-suite rerun. No raw data upload.
